author: BNK Invest
title: Dow Movers: DWDP, AAPL
text:
Shutterstock photo In early trading on Thursday, shares of Apple ( AAPL ) topped the list of the day's best performing Dow Jones Industrial Average components, trading up 0.9%. Year to date, Apple registers a 20.1% gain.
And the worst performing Dow component thus far on the day is DowDuPont ( DWDP ), trading down 2.7%. DowDuPont is lower by about 7.1% looking at the year to date performance.
Two other components making moves today are Boeing ( BA ), trading down 1.1%, and Nike ( NKE ), trading up 0.4% on the day.
